recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. No follow-up is needed unless future Location.mode edits restore modifier wording without restoring an isModifier flag and work-group approval.
issue_request: FHIR-52045 was an Applied/Persuasive PA change request reporting that Location.mode had isModifier=false while the comments still said it was labeled as a modifier, and asking that the contradiction be corrected.
initial_application: The Jira resolution says PA could not find the exact earlier Jira or gForge ticket that removed the isModifier flag, but observed that R4 and later no longer treated Location.mode as a modifier. The stale comment remained until the FHIR-52045 application.
additional_context: FHIR-13066 is the earlier Published/Persuasive issue asking to remove the Location.mode modifier flag. PA minutes on 2025-09-02 record investigation into what triggered the original change, and the 2025 September WGM minutes record an 8-0-0 motion to correct the description. Commit b57689e1ee16b2eb83ef3d27ee6a0b85d74157d8 applied FHIR-52045 by removing the stale Location.mode modifier comment.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the active current Location source has no isModifier flag and no modifier rationale comment on Location.mode, so the applied FHIR-52045 change is already in the current build-scoped source.
